encoding.R: .5 + signed edge distance / 16, native 256-cell pixels; positive outside
encoding.G: Float32 Gaussian convolution of exact wire coverage, sigmas 1.5/4/8 native pixels, weights 1.8/1/.35, compressed as 1-exp(-energy)
encoding.B: Nearest authored wire radius / 2; used only for analytic pixel coverage
encoding.A: Distance along the wire from the lead (lowest point), per glyph 0..1; ignition front and drifting discharge patches

runtime: Analytic fwidth edge AA; no blur baked into core
